newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks close mixed in post-G7 lull.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks close mixed in post-G7 lull.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed a subdued Monday session mixed, with little effect from the G7 summit in Denver at the weekend, which yielded no surprising news.
But the yen's slight weakening against the dollar gave a lift to some export-oriented shares, brokers said.
The 225-share Nikkei average ended 50.60 points or 0.25 percent higher at 20,436.14, after briefly rising to 20,461.55. Its September futures ended down 60 at 20,410.
"The summit is over, which gave relief to the market, but the market still awaits the 'tankan' survey," said Keiko Kondo, a strategist at Merrill Lynch Japan Inc.
The Bank of Japan's quarterly survey of corporate sentiment, called the "tankan", is due to be issued on Wednesday morning.
